name: etch
description: Generate and edit images from Codex with the etch CLI (OpenAI, Gemini, FLUX)

interface.shortDescription: Generate and edit images with OpenAI, Gemini, and FLUX
interface.longDescription: Adds an etch skill that generates or edits images from a prompt using the etch command-line tool. Requires etch (npm install -g etch-image) and an API key for at least one provider.
